command:
set -eu; mkdir -p /workspace/omega_runtime/archive; cp /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py /workspace/omega_runtime/archive/omega_daemon.pre-epoch-fix.$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ).py; python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py')
s=p.read_text()
old="c.execute('INSERT INTO epoch VALUES(?,?,?,?,?)',(eid,now(),latest('epoch'),'RUNNING'))"
new="c.execute('INSERT INTO epoch VALUES(?,?,?,?)',(eid,now(),latest('epoch'),'RUNNING'))"
if old not in s: raise SystemExit('EXPECTED_PATTERN_NOT_FOUND')
p.write_text(s.replace(old,new,1))
PY
python3 -m py_compile /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py; python3 /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py --once; if ! tmux has-session -t omega-grid 2>/dev/null; then tmux new-session -d -s omega-grid 'python3 /workspace/omega_runtime/omega_daemon.py >>/workspace/omega_runtime/omega-grid.log 2>&1'; fi; sleep 2; echo '=== STATUS ==='; cat /workspace/omega_runtime/state/STATUS.json; echo '=== TMUX ==='; tmux list-sessions; echo '=== COUNTS ==='; sqlite3 /workspace/omega_runtime/state/omega.sqlite3 'select count(*) from epoch;select count(*) from frame;select count(*) from effect;'
